rules.predicate: task belongs to a source series and has source array position
rules.action: canonical order is task_series.source_series then task.sequence_position; adjacent source array entries define default predecessor/successor

rules.predicate: task is accepted, progressed and submitted
rules.action: publish -> accept -> in_progress -> completable -> submit -> completed; only submit grants rewards and consumes required deliverables

rules.predicate: issuer, target or completion NPC is missing or globally ambiguous but raw NPC name and task location are explicit
rules.action: first resolve by exact name plus exact location; otherwise create a stable task-context NPC identity keyed by name and location without changing source text

rules.predicate: NPC placement is absent from static placement tables but task receive/submit/target location is explicit
rules.action: create contextual placement scoped to task lifecycle instead of rejecting the task

rules.predicate: target kinds are npc, monster, item or location
rules.action: map to talk, combat, acquire/deliver or movement executor; mixed targets compose executors in source order

rules.predicate: imported target kind is monster but the raw target name is an item, the task text uses an acquisition verb, and one placed encounter is uniquely named as its source
rules.action: preserve the raw record, normalize only the runtime target to item acquisition, and attach the source encounter plus reversible derivation metadata

rules.predicate: a task destination is a source-explicit sailing route encounter rather than a normal city port
rules.action: treat the encounter location and map node as a formal intermediate voyage destination; entering it preserves the active voyage for later resumption

rules.predicate: a task completes successfully
rules.action: money, experience, items, equipment and story flags enter persistent player state before the successor task is evaluated

rules.predicate: a later task is evaluated
rules.action: use projected task-entry level, experience, money, inventory, equipment, health and stamina after all prerequisite rewards and permitted preparation

rules.predicate: level, money, health, stamina or equipment is insufficient at immediate task entry
rules.action: classify as player preparation when repeatable training, recovery, shops, drops or selling can close the gap; do not treat simulator non-completion as game impossibility

rules.predicate: task names a monster or boss and a matching encounter exists at the target location
rules.action: bind normal, elite, leader and boss identity by canonical monster plus location; do not substitute by level alone

rules.predicate: task text explicitly says an encounter yields a required item but no standalone drop definition exists
rules.action: create a task-scoped item and deterministic task drop relation from the uniquely named encounter; preserve unresolved probability as compatibility adjudication

rules.predicate: combat requires stronger equipment
rules.action: use source-backed shop, drop and prior reward acquisition; permit buy, replace and sell within source restrictions; reject circular acquisition plans

rules.predicate: multiple fights or tasks occur consecutively
rules.action: carry health, stamina, consumables, money, inventory and equipment through settlement; allow source-backed recovery and repeatable training between tasks

rules.predicate: two or more fixed repositories agree on a field or behavior
rules.action: adopt automatically with high confidence and retain all source pointers

rules.predicate: repositories provide non-conflicting complementary fields
rules.action: merge field-wise and record provenance per field

rules.predicate: names differ only by known city, NPC, monster, item or identifier aliases
rules.action: normalize to canonical identity while retaining raw source labels

rules.predicate: sources materially conflict
rules.action: prefer explicit primary-source task data, then multi-source agreement, exact contextual resolution, adjacent-chain consistency, auxiliary evidence and finally minimal compatibility inference; unresolved substantive conflicts remain registered

rules.predicate: a small field is absent but exact task text, adjacent tasks and entity placement imply one unique value
rules.action: apply the smallest reversible runtime overlay, record derivation and confidence, and do not rewrite source records

rules.predicate: task is structurally imported
rules.action: all 651 tasks exist in the unified directory; validation and blocker status are metadata, not import gates
